findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] Matches how-to I430 (Securing local sensitive data): the reset code is never persisted as sent - hash_reset_code derives the stored form with HMAC-SHA256 under settings.OTP_HMAC_KEY, a key supplied out-of-band by the environment/secret store rather than held alongside the data it protects, and reset_code_matches compares in constant time via hmac.compare_digest. Codes are generated with secrets.randbelow, carry a 10-minute expiry and an attempt budget | verdict=pass confidence=high

[AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] No column stores confidential data in cleartext. User.password holds an argon2id hash, User.reset_password_code holds the keyed HMAC derivation, and the remaining columns (token_version, failed_logins, locked_until, reset_password_attempts) are non-secret state. There are no serialized/pickled object columns, so the TA277 amendment on serialized objects has nothing to flag. A read of the users table yields no usable secret, which is the security property ctx.text requires | verdict=pass confidence=high
